stories.title: Nobel per la Chimica 2026 a Henri Kagan e a Kenso Soai per gli studi nella sintesi organica

en.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026 awarded to Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai for organic synthesis studies
en.summary: Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai received the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their research on how chemical reactions can spontaneously produce a single form of a chiral molecule without involving other chiral molecules.

stories.title: Henri Kagan e Kenso Soai hanno vinto il Nobel per la Chimica 2026

en.title: Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry
en.summary: Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, which includes 1.1 million euros. The previous year's prize recognized discoveries of new porous materials with large internal surfaces.

stories.title: National health system endured 18.8 bn in 'invisible' cuts 2023-2026 - Gimbe

en.title: National health system endured 18.8 bn in 'invisible' cuts 2023-2026 - Gimbe
en.summary: A report indicates the national health system experienced 18.8 billion in undisclosed budget cuts between 2023 and 2026, with an additional 32 billion needed over the next three years.

stories.title: Gimbe, 18,8 miliardi di tagli invisibili alla sanità tra 2023 e 2026

en.title: Gimbe, 18.8 billion in invisible cuts to healthcare between 2023 and 2026
en.summary: Healthcare received 18.8 billion in undisclosed budget cuts from 2023 to 2026, with 32 billion needed in the coming three years, according to a report.

en.title: Electoral law in final rush, Chamber approves confidence vote on article 3
en.summary: The Chamber of Deputies voted on electoral law provisions, with final approval scheduled for tomorrow through secret ballot.

stories.title: Gimbe, la sanità pubblica perde 18,8 miliardi: crescono costi, assicurazioni e rinunce alle cure

en.title: Gimbe, public healthcare loses 18.8 billion: costs, insurance, and care denials grow
en.summary: Italy's healthcare system faces pressure as assistance costs rise, regions struggle with spending, millions forgo medical visits, and healthcare staffing remains insufficient.

stories.title: Sinner non perderà solo punti: ecco i mancati guadagni per lo stop fino al 2027

en.title: Sinner will not only lose points: here are the missed earnings from the suspension until 2027
en.summary: Sinner faces financial losses beyond ranking points, missing over 18 million euros in potential tournament prize money and bonuses due to his suspension.

stories.title: Il Nobel per la Chimica a Kagan e Soari

en.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry awarded to Kagan and Soari
en.summary: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry is awarded to Henri Kagan and Kenso Soari for discovering nonlinear effects of autocatalysis in organic synthesis.

stories.title: La sanità pubblica perde 18,8 miliardi: sempre più italiani rinunciano a esami e visite

en.title: Public healthcare loses 18.8 billion: more and more Italians forgo exams and visits
en.summary: Italy's public health system faces a funding shortfall of 18.8 billion euros, with increasing numbers of citizens skipping medical examinations and visits. Italians spend 1,013 euros less per capita on healthcare than the EU average, and officials warn the burden may shift to patients.

stories.title: Sopravvive a due iniezioni letali, Christa Pike si risveglia in ospedale

en.title: Survives two lethal injections, Christa Pike wakes up in hospital
en.summary: A woman sentenced to death in Tennessee in 1996 regained consciousness after receiving two doses of pentobarbital. Her legal team is requesting a commutation of her sentence amid disputes over responsibility and potential further execution.

stories.title: Christa Pike, sopravvissuta a due iniezioni letali negli Usa, è cosciente e parla

en.title: Christa Pike, survived two lethal injections in the US, is conscious and speaking
en.summary: A death-sentenced woman has regained consciousness and regained the ability to speak after surviving execution. Her legal team characterizes the situation as without precedent.

stories.title: Christa Pike, due iniezioni letali e il fallimento della pena di morte

en.title: Christa Pike, two lethal injections and the failure of capital punishment
en.summary: Christa Pike, age 50, survived two lethal injection attempts during her execution in Tennessee after nearly three decades on death row. The failed execution prompted a state suspension of capital punishment and renewed debate over the death penalty in the United States.

stories.title: Smart working, la pausa pranzo viene penalizzata

en.title: Smart working, lunch break is penalized
en.summary: Remote work arrangements present unexpected drawbacks for lunch breaks, including isolation, skipped meals, and reduced social interaction opportunities among employees.

stories.title: Morato Group cresce in Germania, nasce un polo di eccellenza del bakery

en.title: Morato Group expands in Germany, establishing a bakery excellence hub
en.summary: Morato Group, founded in 1970 and based in Altavilla Vicentina near Vicenza, acquires German bakery company Jaus Bakery to establish a European center of excellence in the baking sector.

stories.title: In Valle d’Aosta il gruppo Hti apre un hub tecnologico

en.title: In Valle d'Aosta the Hti group opens a technology hub
en.summary: The Hti Group, which owns Leitner cable car systems, Prinoth snow groomers, and Demaclenko snowmaking equipment, is strengthening its presence in the northwestern region by opening a technology hub in Valle d'Aosta.

stories.title: Dal 20 al 22 ottobre a NetZero confronto sulla elettrificazione dell’economia

en.title: October 20-22 at NetZero discussion on economy electrification
en.summary: NetZero Milan, a Fiera Milano event, hosts its second edition addressing energy costs, industrial competitiveness, and ecological transition challenges related to economic electrification.

en.title: Poggipolini, with hi-tech welding new orders from Leonardo
en.summary: Poggipolini is securing new contracts from Leonardo through advanced welding technology used in aerospace manufacturing at its Aviomec facility in Mornago.
